claim: Choosing props by what tiles they keep company with (PMI over the campaign) finds what goes with what -- the candelabrum 580 with walls 100 and 119, the chandelier 1701 with floor 110 -- but it put a dead tree (540, outdoors 61% of the time) in a saloon and a boulder on its bar, because both share plank walls in the corpus. Gate associations by context: whether the tile stands under sky, and judgement for terrain.
evidence: Gravesend's dressing pass, projects/blood-city/level/props.py (ASSOCIATIONS, sky_share, the terrain exclusion)
use: Use props_for with its sky gate; never decorate from a single marginal statistic.
